buonaparte.translation: family 波拿巴家族(即Bonaparte family)

buoy.definition:
n. bright-colored; a float attached by rope to the seabed to mark channels in a harbor or underwater hazards
v. float on the surface of water
v. keep afloat
v. mark with a buoy
buoy.translation:
n. 浮标, 航标, 救生圈
vt. 使浮起, 鼓励

buoy up.translation: 使浮起, 使不下沉, 使在空中飘浮

buoyage.definition:
n. Buoys, taken collectively; a series of buoys, as for the
   guidance of vessels into or out of port; the providing of buoys.
buoyage.translation: n. 浮标, 浮标装置, 浮标装置方法

buoyance.translation: n. 浮力, 弹性, 快活, 轻快, (股票市场)保持高价

buoyancy.definition:
n. cheerfulness that bubbles to the surface
n. the tendency to float in water or other liquid
buoyancy.translation:
n. 浮力, 弹性, 快活, 轻快, (股票市场)保持高价
[化] 浮力; 浮扬性

buoyant.definition:
s. tending to float on a liquid or rise in air or gas
s. characterized by liveliness and lightheartedness
buoyant.translation:
a. 有浮力的, 心情愉快的
[经] 降而复升的, 保持高价的, 遂之而升的

buoyantly.definition: r. in a cheerfully buoyant manner
buoyantly.translation: adv. 有浮力地, 轻快地

buoyed.translation: v. 使浮起( buoy的过去式和过去分词 ); 支持; 为…设浮标; 振奋…的精神

buoying.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Buoy
buoying.translation: v. 使浮起( buoy的现在分词 ); 支持; 为…设浮标; 振奋…的精神

buoys.definition:
n bright-colored; a float attached by rope to the seabed to mark channels in a harbor or underwater hazards
v float on the surface of water
v keep afloat
v mark with a buoy
buoys.translation:
n. 浮标( buoy的名词复数 ); 航标; 救生圈; 救生衣
v. 使浮起( buoy的第三人称单数 ); 支持; 为…设浮标; 振奋…的精神
